text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One evening, after a bit of shopping,

Matikanefukukitaru and I are walking
through the
shopping district when...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Look at all those people. Do you
think a
fortune teller has set up shop or
something?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with our
New
Year's raffle! This year's grand-prize
is a hot
spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot
hamburger steak! Second-prize winners
get a bushel of carrots! And third-prize
winners can take home a
single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
How about you over there with the
daruma charm
on your head? Care to
give it a spin?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
A raffle? A game that tests our luck?!
Mwahaha!
The gods must have wanted
me to see this!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's like drawing a fortune slip with a
prize
attached! There's no way we can
pass this up!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, some change please... No, you
have a
raffle ticket, don't you?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wooo! Okay, let's join hands and fuse
our
energies into one!
choice_data_list: I'm pretty sure I got one ticket w...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
With our luck combined, there's nothing
to fear! I
just know it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our spiritual energies channeled as one,
we reach
out and grasp the handle of
the raffle spinner...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She belts out a rattling cry as we give it
a strong
crank.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A small plastic ball drops from the
spinner's
opening...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a
grand-prize winner! Come and get the
coupon for your hot
spring vacation!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wooooo! Praise be! Receiving the
grand-prize is
just like receiving a great
blessing at the shrine!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
With both the gods and Buddha in this
world, I
guess we reap double the
rewards for good
deeds!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Wahoo! Wahoo! Wa-wa-hurray!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't know where she came up with
that chant,
but Matikanefukukitaru
seems to be over the
moon.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Woooo! We really won! That means we
can go
together!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
We just have to decide when. A lucky
trip like this
needs to have an
appropriately auspicious day.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
So it would probably be best to leave it
up to the
fortune slips. What do you say,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
All right then! Onward to today's second
lucky
draw!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'll leave it to you.
Yeah, I'll leave it to you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We head to a shrine to let the fortune
slips
determine the date for our
vacation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The slips usually have a section on them
devoted
to travel plans, so we decide to
use that for
reference.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
All right,
let's give this an unravel... And
here we
are!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now, what do we have here...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Gyahhhhh! What does this mean?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe this! It usually says
something like "the present time is
fortuitous" or "a location in
the northeast
would be favorable."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
But look! It says, "You're gonna want to
wait a
year—trust me. ♪"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Pretty direct for a fortune, don't you
think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One year... I guess the gods want us to
wait a
while.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what a shame. However, to ignore a
direction
from the divine would be a
grave transgression.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Good things come to those who wait,
after all! I'm
sure there's a very good
reason for the delay.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, it's only one year! Will you join
me for
the hot springs when that time
comes?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, the hot springs aren't going

anywhere! And if they did, I'd chase
them down.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Okay, it's a promise! I'm gonna hold you
to it!
choice_data_list: All right, then in one year.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And when that day comes, we'll soak in
there for
hours on end and feast on the
finest local
delicacies!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Put 'er there, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The clasp of our handshake echoes
through the air. With a hot spring trip to
look forward to, Matikanefukukitaru's
enthusiasm is at an all-time
high.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize
winner!
Congratulations! You get one
deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! It's not the grand-prize, but this
isn't half
bad! I'd compare it to pulling
"good fortune" on a
fortune slip!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! It's so packed with nutrients,
just one
bite will probably take you
straight to heaven.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And the carrot's reddish hue looks
awfully
auspicious...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hmm... But it's still missing something.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's lacking the rich flavors befitting a
New Year's feast. If we want this
hamburger steak to be even
more
auspicious...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I've got it! Come with me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide to go along with whatever

Matikanefukukitaru has in mind.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
We can use the kitchen here to make a
cream
sauce to go on top of the
hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now it's ready! The reddish carrot and
white cream sauce together give it a
celebratory flair!
That's a lucky color
combination, you know!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
What joy! What bliss! All right, Trainer,
let's dig
in!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We enjoy the meal together. Her
homemade
sauce really adds a rich,
creamy depth to the dish!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's your
lucky day!
You're going home with a
bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Carrots, eh? Well, the sheer number of
them is
nothing to scoff at, so I'd say this
is about the same as "modest fortune" on
a fortune slip.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
We should definitely be accepting them
with
gratitude in our hearts.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Still, it wouldn't do to keep these all to
ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I know! Trainer, why don't we go on a
pilgrimage
of good fortune, sharing our
blessings far and
wide?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we go around handing out
carrots to all
the Umamusume we meet.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Fukukitaru. I'll eat it during
my break
at training.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oho! The heck do we have here? A
carrot? Don't
mind if I do!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I owe you one. And I always pay my
debts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After handing out three carrots...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hey, wait just a second! At this rate,
we'll be at
this until morning!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Why don't we just eat the rest of them!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cutting our pilgrimage short at three
stops, we
gorge on the rest of the
carrots.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won the

third-prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! Just one measly carrot?! This
must be
the work of the demon-goddess
Kishimojin!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If this were a fortune slip, maybe it
would be "modest fortune." Eh, on
second thought, it's
more like... "meh
fortune."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't remember ever seeing "meh
fortune" on
one of those slips before,
but sure.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Still, even one carrot makes for a
preeetty good
snack. Let's dig in,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We split the carrot in half and enjoy a
small snack
together.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
All finished? Okay. Let us bring our
humble feast
to a close, and celebrate
with the traditional
single clap!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Aaaand...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sound of our clap echoes through
the air. It
somehow makes the whole
event feel a bit more
special.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled
a blank
one! Take this pack of tissues as
a consolation
prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Tissues?! Is this the malady that has
been
forewarned for centuries—do we
have a "dud" on
our hands?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: This is just like receiving "misfortune" on a fortune slip! No, make that "great misfortune"! How could this happen to us?! Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's turn this around and make
paper
dolls out of them!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
To ward off evil spirits. They'll take the
brunt of
the bad luck for us.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
There's no time to waste! Let's get to
folding!
Chop-chop!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We make paper dolls out of all the
tissues. Their
faces are crumpled with
misfortune.
